seed_requirement.caveat: the between-seed standard deviation is estimated from 3 seeds and is itself uncertain; treat this as a planning floor, not a power calculation
seed_requirement.rule: seeds such that the standard error of the seed-mean CE delta falls below 0.2 of the 0.05 nats/token guard, for the worst single-layer sublayer scope
